facts.fact: ICTD says Rwanda's two mobile operators run MTN MoMo and Airtel Money mobile money platforms.
ICTD reports that since July 2026 eKash carries cross-operator payments between MTN and Airtel wallets and bank accounts.

ICTD describes eKash as the national interoperable digital payment and retail system run by RSwitch, connecting commercial banks, microfinance institutions and mobile money operators; BNR reported 28.9 million eKash transactions in September 2026.
